children: The Indonesian rupiah is likely to weaken further if the country loses its emerging-market status by index provider MSCI Inc., says Abbas Keshvani at RBC Capital Markets in a commentary. The potential move by MSCI to reclassify Indonesia's status from emerging-market to standalone would result in $5 billion of outflows, he says. RBC remains bearish on the rupiah, as the country relies on portfolio flows to fund its current account deficit. Both equity flows and debt flows are likely to be weak, he adds. The dollar is last 0.2% lower at 17,995 rupiah.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
